spatial_support_rule: Assign each checklist to support_id by verified point-in-polygon or documented support assignment; if sensitive/coarse locations exist, route through a disclosure-safe support bucket, not exact geometry.
temporal_join_rule: Use observation date month (YYYY-MM) and align to monthly hydrology row with the same month label.
forbidden_uses: Do not infer absences from incomplete checklists, opportunistic entries, or non-coverage weeks. Exclude if checklist is not complete-checklist class.
validation_checks: require complete-checklist flag, checklist duration/effort fields, minimum effort completeness, hydrology join success, one row per (support_id, month, stream_record_id) in core lanes.

spatial_support_rule: Assign each checklist and count to support_id using the same privacy-aware support assignment rule as l01; retain effort-adjusted effort_area fields.
temporal_join_rule: Align all count summaries to observation month; avoid cross-month carry-forward without explicit lag model.
forbidden_uses: Do not treat raw observed count as raw abundance; do not use under-sampled weeks without effort offsets.
validation_checks: minimum effort thresholds (distance, duration, observers), duplicate-avoidance across repeated submissions, effort covariate completeness.

spatial_support_rule: Join to support_id if explicit wetland/site identifier is provided; otherwise coordinate-based assignment with conservative nearest-support and manual QA.
temporal_join_rule: Use survey date to the 1st-of-month grain unless exact timestamp is used in downstream sensitivity checks.
forbidden_uses: Do not combine with eBird opportunistically without duplicate resolution and protocol harmonisation.
validation_checks: Require protocol tags, survey completeness where available, and explicit duplicate/overlap handling with eBird imports.

spatial_support_rule: Only accept breeding evidence fields with explicit nest/reproductive-confirmation flags and support assignment.
temporal_join_rule: Use survey month and explicit breeding windows; avoid pooling across non-matching years unless model states a pooled prior.
forbidden_uses: Do not convert breeding flags to year-round occurrence without temporal gating.
validation_checks: Validate breeding flags are explicit and time-gated; retain as validation-only until overlap with effort assumptions is agreed.

spatial_support_rule: Use only if record has clear, non-absence provider geometry/provenance; apply sensitivity-aware or gridded location where required.
temporal_join_rule: Use month or event-period label; keep temporal granularity coarser than core lanes if source precision is coarse.
forbidden_uses: Never use as non-detection source. Never fit core reaction curves from ALA-only presence snapshots.
validation_checks: Provider-level licence tracking, sensitivity filtering, coordinate precision checks, and source-specific licence retention.

spatial_support_rule: Join only where wetland-name or survey-coverage metadata can map to documented support_id with a reviewed crosswalk.
temporal_join_rule: Use EAWS wetland/year survey period metadata and keep temporal windows separate from core monthly synthesis.
forbidden_uses: Do not use EAWS as replacement for survey effort offsets unless method mapping is completed.
validation_checks: Require published field dictionary, reuse terms, wetland crosswalk verification, and explicit validation-only status.
